An '''Onderon Guardian's pike''' was a type of [[Lightsaber pike/Legends|lightsaber pike]] produced by the [[Onderonian/Legends|Onderonians]]<ref name="Cartel Market" /> during the [[Third Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|6.0}}</ref>
